capabilities: Browse vault folders as a card grid of collections and items
Set card covers by drag-and-drop, frontmatter, embeds, or folder images
Toggle a Read/Watched done status on item notes
Create the next numbered note in a series folder
Rename collection display titles and open a library homepage on startup
disambiguation: Not a connector to online media databases or streaming services; it tracks media that already exists as local notes and downloads no covers from the internet.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes migration guidance: older filenames containing # do not sync to Android via Self-hosted LiveSync and must be renamed manually.
problem: Obsidian has no visual card-grid view for browsing and tracking media collections stored as plain notes and folders.

relations.evidence: no # in filenames, so files sync cleanly on Android via Self-hosted LiveSync

summary: Card-grid media tracker that treats vault folders as collections and notes as items, with covers, read status, and next-issue creation.
